name: CF Rotary
description: Simple mono Leslie-style rotary, replacing RA200X (no audio, crashed USB audio with effects after it). 1-pole 800 Hz crossover; horn band gets a short modulated (Doppler) delay plus AM, drum band AM only; independent horn/drum spin-up. Delay line in the slot work buffer (fails to silence if absent, as CE2X/DLYX do). TEST: cost and work-buffer availability not yet measured on the pedal.

params.name: Depth
params.explanation: Doppler + AM depth, horn and drum.
